The review found one critical internal inconsistency in the textual brief for FIG. 4, where the prose description of the flowchart shapes contradicted the numeral list in the same file. The prose described one diamond shape and seven rectangles, while the numeral list correctly identified two diamond shapes (for decision steps 210 and 214) and six rectangles. A fix has been provided to correct the prose to align with the numeral list and standard flowchart conventions.

With this correction, the application text and figure specifications are fully supported by the inventor's disclosure and are internally consistent. No other unsupported assertions, inconsistencies, or drafting artifacts were found.
